ucb.definition: ucb95_normal = point + 1.645 SE_boot (X2 incident-pool bootstrap); ucb95_pct = 95th percentile of the bootstrap replicates; P-LOSO: ucb95_jackknife_t = est + t_{22,0.95} SE_jack and the scenario-bootstrap bounds; prereg cells use P2-G's SE (bootstrap; jackknife for P-LOSO); detectable_violation_80pct = excess over alpha that a one-sided 5% z test would detect with 80% power at that SE (unadjusted; Holm makes it larger)

a=0.1.definition: MDE = (z_{1-level} + z_{0.8}) x SE for the one-sided paired bootstrap test of Delta CER_link > 0 at the Holm step-1 level (0.05/2); SE_boot from P2-G (B = 1000 x 50, fitted models fixed); seed variance = SD of the s0-s4 deltas (fusion-learner refits)

a=0.2.definition: MDE = (z_{1-level} + z_{0.8}) x SE for the one-sided paired bootstrap test of Delta CER_link > 0 at the Holm step-1 level (0.05/2); SE_boot from P2-G (B = 1000 x 50, fitted models fixed); seed variance = SD of the s0-s4 deltas (fusion-learner refits)

two_sample_auc.definition: two-sample AUC = E10's 5-fold cross-validated logistic classifier on the 42-d label-free phi(I) (bank = 0, deployment = 1); p_perm = permutation p-value of the group labels (sizes kept); *_mean5 = statistic averaged over 5 CV seeds; boot_ci = stratified incident bootstrap with duplicates kept in one fold; exchangeable = AUC of random 9-incident 'deployments' drawn from the same pool (null reference; q95 = a pre-statable warning threshold)
